name: Myinsaing Kingdom
native: မြင်စိုင်းပြည် (Myinsaing Pyi)

predecessors.name: Pagan Kingdom
predecessors.text: the Dry Zone around Myinsaing, Kyaukse and Minbu, taken by the three brothers when they overthrew Kyawswa on 17 December 1297

successors.name: Pinya Kingdom
successors.text: the same 672 cells: Cliopatria's Pinya shape of 1314 is identical

rulers.name: Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu (the three brothers)
rulers.title: joint rulers

ledger.x: 17 December 1297: the three Myinsaing brothers overthrow Kyawswa and take over Pagan's heartland.
January 1300: Athinkhaya's army seizes Mongol garrisons at Singu and Male.
4 April 1303: the Mongols withdraw from northern Burma.
1303: after the Mongol withdrawal the brothers take the Kyaukse, Minbu and Mu granaries.
7 February 1313: Thihathu founds Pinya and Myinsaing ends.

wars.name: Mongol campaign against Myinsaing (1300-1303)
wars.outcome: The Mongols reached Myinsaing on 25 January 1301, called off the attack on 6 April 1301 after a bribe and withdrew from northern Burma on 4 April 1303.

certainty.note: The Dry Zone core is firm; the Shan-hill edge and the Prome and Toungoo south are approximate, with Shan states and Martaban beside it.
